runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Skillet Beef and Black Bean Chilli, Tonkatsu Curry, Smoked Haddock with Leeks
runs.content:
1. Skillet Beef and Black Bean Chilli with Quick Cornbread, inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 50-minute one-pot weeknight chilli with buttermilk cornbread for darkening October evenings.
2. Tonkatsu with Japanese Curry, Rice and Shredded Cabbage, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. Panko-crusted pork with a from-scratch roux curry, a nod to the Tokyo katsu counters he loved.
3. Smoked Haddock Baked with Leeks, Cream and Mustard, inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: a quiet 35-minute one-dish autumn fish supper built on sweet seasonal leeks.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Roast Sausages with Grapes, Galbi-jjim, Moules au Cidre
runs.content:
1. Roast Sausages with Red Grapes, Red Onion and Mustard Mash, inspired by Nigel Slater. A 40-minute one-tray weeknight supper where October grapes roast into a jammy, sharp pan sauce.
2. Galbi-jjim (Korean Braised Short Ribs with Daikon and Chestnuts), inspired by David Chang. A weekend braise in soy, pear and garlic that reduces to a sticky glaze, with seasonal chestnuts.
3. Moules au Cidre with Crusty Bread, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: a 20-minute Normandy-style brasserie classic with mussels at their October best.
